A. Request of Councilmembers Brock and Davis that, in support of the annual Fourth of July parade along Main Street: (1) the City should co-produce the parade along with the Ocean Park Association; (2) the City should establish a pilot program that would allow the 2022 parade to be staged in the southernmost beach parking lots and then travel from those lots in a northern route on Main Street to the Civic Center; and (3) that the Council allocate $15,000 of its discretionary funds to the Ocean Park Association to help defray costs associated with producing the parade.
